verification.smuggling: HOSTILE_STRING /[\p{Cc}\u2028\u2029\u202A-\u202E\u2066-\u2069]/gu still at address-overlay-list.ts:196, applied by sanitizeOverlayText to text and title (unchanged by the diff). The range is two integers validated (integers, 0<=start<end<=sent text length, only keys start/end; else the whole row is refused). It is dropped when sanitizing changed the text (strip/truncate shifts offsets), so it can never point at different bytes. The child builds the three parts with slice()+createTextNode/textContent of the already-sanitized text and sets bdi.dir to the constant "ltr": no new text, no innerHTML, no attacker-chosen dir. It can only wrap existing characters in an LTR isolate; it adds no bidi control characters to the text (textContent has none, per facts).
